result.summary: Found two issues: low-contrast interface text and a duplicated restaurant listing.

issues.description: The search placeholder and inactive bottom-navigation labels have low contrast against their backgrounds, making them difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text colors that meet the 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal-sized text.

issues.description: The first two cards in “Fastest near you” show identical Green Bowl Poké listings.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate or add distinguishing details if these represent different locations.
